text:
Jordan: Quick check — planning an ad-hoc cutover for audit-log ingest from staging -> prod next Thu 2026-04-01. Need owners on pipeline, KMS envelope rotation, and S3 retention confirmation. Can owners ack blockers by EOD tomorrow? Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/audit-ingest-cutover

Maria: Ack. Updating the log-shipper chart — config change in PR. Will need a brief index migration (~10m). PR: https://github.com/redwood/shipper/pull/482

Ryan: Infra side ready, dashboards + alerts prepped. Two caveats: the log-archiver lambda needs a new IAM role to decrypt with the rotated key. I can add it but we need security sign-off on the KMS policy change.

Tess: +1 from ops. Recommend 00:00-02:00 UTC window to avoid peak and include a 1% canary replay before full flip. Also suggest a short rollback play: revert DNS pointing to staging shard.

Maria: Added canary pipeline stub to the PR, pinging @security-approvals for key policy review. Also added a smoke-test job to `shipper-ci` that replays 100 events.

security-approvals: New approval request created: KMS policy change (kp-2026-04). Reviewers: Jordan, aya. Please review within 24h to keep cutover on schedule. https://internal.redwood/approvals/kp-2026-04

Jordan: Quick question @ryan — will HSM attestation be required for the rotated key or can we use the current HSM-stored key material? If attestation required, need to schedule HSM slot and update evidence doc.

aya: We can reuse existing HSM key material; no new attestation needed. Rotation must be recorded in the audit evidence spreadsheet and attach the key rotation ticket. I'm adding an evidence row now: `rotation-2026-04-01, owner: aya, doc: https://internal.redwood/docs/evidence`

Ryan: Thanks. I'll add the IAM role change + KMS key policy patch to the infra PR and drop a smoke script: `./scripts/smoke-audit-ingest.sh --env prod --count 100`. Will test in staging canary first.

devops-bot: Deploy window tentative: 2026-04-01T00:00Z -> 2026-04-01T02:00Z. To lock window run: `/deploy lock audit-ingest-cutover --window 2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-01T02:00Z`

Jordan: Next steps summarized: Maria — finalize PR + add canary; Ryan — add IAM/KMS changes + smoke script; aya — add evidence row and attach ticket; Security-approvals — review kp-2026-04. If no blockers by EOD tomorrow we do a dry-run on Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
